title: Telco IQ build-time capability and evaluation register
publicContentPolicy: Original synthetic lab design and public product references only; no customer records, private source material, credentials or target environment identifiers.

customerDemo.readinessPolicy: Establish current playback and native live readiness separately per stream; historical acceptance is not a current reader grant.

limitations: The executive native answer is distinct from deterministic application review cards.
Independent source queries are not an exposed native internal trace; original times remain separate.
Historical advanced partial results and failed arms remain qualified.
The three fresh live pairs passed actual current-session source checks; an archive is not a reusable reader grant.
Earlier failed and interrupted attempts remain retained, not relabelled as successful.
Advanced partial results and unknown exclusions remain partial.
The historical October22 recovery traditional arm failed and remains NOT_COMPARABLE; the final October28 pair executed in both arms with PARTIAL/common-source-state qualifications.
No general ontology accuracy or performance advantage is inferred.
Customer-demo delivery does not promote E01-E24 or override release-claim gates.

upstream.warning: Refreshed ontology authoring skill still describes the old JSON format; current new-experience Learn contracts take precedence.

stateMachine.dependencySemantics: Prerequisite experiment outcomes must be evaluated; an unavailable feature blocks only dependent capability claims, not independent adapters or offline work.
stateMachine.unavailablePolicy: Block only dependent capability claims; continue independent work. Never replace a missing native capability with an unlabeled mock.

experiments.title: New-experience availability and generation
experiments.hypothesis: The approved DEV tenant can create and read a generation-2 Ontology item using the current public contract.
experiments.unknown: Actual tenant/capacity/region enablement, rollout and role prerequisites.
procedure: Record approved target, current identity, capacity and tenant settings without changing them.
After explicit mutation approval, create a disposable empty ontology through the documented create interface.
Read item properties and definition using author permissions; record generation and actual definition parts.
Exercise a missing-permission identity and retain its explicit failure.
experiments.pass: New-experience item exists and readback matches the expected generation and TMDL structure; denied identity remains denied.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Continue offline generator/models; record feature unavailable, do not silently create old ontology and call it equivalent.

experiments.title: Two-model grounding, reconciliation and cross-model query
experiments.hypothesis: One native ontology can use both semantic models and correctly align approved shared entities.
experiments.unknown: Actual source-binding versus semantic-grounding representation and overlap reconciliation behavior.
procedure: Generate ontology from model A with the documented UI action.
In the built-in ontology agent, request model B in Plan mode, review, then approve Act mode.
Include one genuinely conformed key and one identically named but incompatible key.
Inspect resulting entities, namespaces, model lineage and relationships.
Ask a known cross-model aggregate and an invalid-key question.
experiments.pass: Known cross-model answer equals oracle, source identities survive, and incompatible identities are not silently merged.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Record exact failure/representation; retain separate models and run portal/native-snapshot diagnostic lanes without claiming full custom-app native consumption.

experiments.title: Source-owned metrics and home-table association
experiments.hypothesis: Generated ontology metrics retain correct source model, home table and source measure identity.
experiments.unknown: Home-table association for cross-table DAX, same-name metrics and utility measure tables.
procedure: Create two models each with a Revenue measure having a different business sense.
Place one multi-table DAX measure on a meaningful domain table and one test measure on a utility table.
Generate/refresh ontology and inspect native metric identity, description, source and table.
Ask a source-specific and an ambiguous metric question and compare source DAX results.
experiments.pass: Each metric maps to its actual source/home table; ambiguous senses are not collapsed; numerical values match the intended source calculation.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Preserve source-qualified measure selection and disclose missing native metadata; do not manufacture native metrics in app JSON.

experiments.title: Metric metadata versus DAX-expression permissions
experiments.hypothesis: A reader can use authorized metric context without receiving source DAX or ontology authoring permission.
experiments.unknown: Minimum read/query permissions differ across GA IQ MCP, native ontology, ontology MCP and definition export.
procedure: Test separate readers with Read, Read+Build and author Write access, without elevated workspace roles.
Inspect metric name/description/source, query the source measure and request Resolve underlying DAX.
Attempt getDefinition with reader identity and confirm the documented author-only boundary.
Ensure expression lookup failure does not trigger permission escalation or an invented formula.
experiments.pass: Observed permission matrix is explicit; reader mode works with authorized metadata/results while forbidden expressions and definitions remain unavailable.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Reduce runtime features or require the documented reader permissions; never grant Write solely to simplify app context reads.

experiments.title: Ontology MCP tool discovery and context completeness
experiments.hypothesis: The direct ontology MCP endpoint exposes enough authorized native context for the custom app.
experiments.unknown: Actual tool inventory, scopes, schemas, metric exposure, transport and differences among ask_ontology/search_ontology and gateway surfaces.
procedure: Connect with documented delegated OAuth and negotiate the MCP protocol/transport.
Capture initialize and tools/list schemas, effects and pagination without storing credentials.
Look for the documented entity/rule/question tools; use actual returned names and schemas.
Retrieve the fixture's entities, relationships, rules, source model IDs and metric provenance.
Allowlist only read-only tools; deny any definition-management tool to the runtime agent.
experiments.pass: A current native-context receipt identifies the required sources/metrics/rules, schemas are validated and no runtime mutation tool is callable.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Use a clearly labelled native-snapshot mode for development and portal reference lane; mark native external context claim incomplete.

experiments.title: GA IQ MCP analytic tool contracts
experiments.hypothesis: The app can use the six GA tools for discover/schema/values/per-model DAX with the pinned variant.
experiments.unknown: Exact current input/output schemas, query-count bounds, maxRows and session requirements.
procedure: Use the GA endpoint and the default Fabric IQ toolset (or an explicit X-Variants header when testing a specific version) on every request.
Capture schemas for DiscoverArtifacts, ResolveFabricItem, GetReportMetadata, GetSemanticModelSchema, ValueSearch and ExecuteQuery.
Discover both fixture models, retrieve schema, resolve one value and execute one governed measure per model.
Test the documented absent-Build permission case independently from ontology permissions.
Confirm the adapter never asks this endpoint to directly resolve an ontology.
experiments.pass: Live source values equal oracle, tool arguments validate against current schemas, and each query receipt identifies exactly one model.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Surface auth/tool/version failure; direct REST is a separate labelled diagnostic, not an invisible replacement for IQ MCP.

experiments.title: Delegated app identity and RLS/OLS
experiments.hypothesis: The custom browser/backend app preserves the signed-in user's entitlements through both context and query paths.
experiments.unknown: Practical OAuth/OBO integration for the chosen direct MCP endpoints.
procedure: Implement single-tenant DEV browser sign-in and backend token validation.
Exchange an API-addressed user token for the correct downstream resource using the verified delegated flow.
Run identical questions as all-regions, regional, care-only and enterprise-restricted readers.
Inspect source results and metadata visibility, not just final prose.
Switch users and revoke one model permission, then repeat warm-cache requests.
experiments.pass: Authorized results match per-persona oracle; denied data and metadata never leak via context, caches, counts or explanations.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Keep isolated single-user local development with an explicit limitation; do not ship privileged multi-user impersonation.

experiments.title: Ontology-only formula edit versus source calculation
experiments.hypothesis: Ontology-local formula edits do not mutate source DAX, and consumer behavior can be characterized without assuming execution semantics.
experiments.unknown: Whether each consumer treats a formula edit as contextual guidance, an alternate calculation, unsupported text or another behavior.
procedure: Record original metric metadata and source DAX result on fixed data.
On a disposable ontology copy edit the local metric formula and description only.
Requery the source directly and ask the native portal, ontology MCP and custom app equivalent questions.
Compare query text, selected metric identities and returned values.
Restore the ontology and repeat.
experiments.pass: Source calculation is unchanged; every observed consumer behavior is documented and the app never silently treats contextual text as a certified source measure.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Use description-only enrichment and source-owned measures; expose alternate formulas as unverified hypothetical context.

experiments.title: Four freshness clocks and source change propagation
experiments.hypothesis: Source values, model definitions, ontology metadata and app caches can be invalidated independently and correctly.
experiments.unknown: What source changes require ontology refresh and how changes become visible to each consumer.
procedure: Change only data, then only DAX, then only a measure description, and finally a relationship/schema.
Capture values and metadata before any refresh, after source refresh, after ontology refresh and after app cache invalidation.
Rename a model/measure and verify stable lineage, stale references and failure reporting.
Measure refresh and rename durations and check that metadata edits do not revert unexpectedly.
experiments.pass: Freshness timestamps/revisions explain every observed difference; stale definitions are detected; stable references preserve identity or fail explicitly.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Require a documented explicit refresh procedure and visible stale-context status rather than claiming automatic synchronization.

experiments.title: DAX metric ALM round-trip fidelity
experiments.hypothesis: The actual supported export/import path can be measured without destroying source-linked metrics.
experiments.unknown: Current loss of backingMeasure/targetScopes and any supported public alternative to TMDL for source-linked metrics.
procedure: Census native source-linked metrics and create a named backup or retain the original item.
Export via documented getDefinition using an authorized author.
Import ONLY into a disposable new ontology; never overwrite the original.
Compare metric identities, backing links, target scopes, rules, namespaces and query results.
Use an alternative JSON management route only if its public endpoint/contract is documented and approved.
experiments.pass: Either an evidenced lossless supported route succeeds, or the experiment correctly identifies loss and prevents its use as the deployment path.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Retain human-assisted native metric bootstrap, source-controlled intent/model artifacts and readback inventories; do not claim complete ontology CI/CD.

experiments.title: Native rules affect planning without prompt edits
experiments.hypothesis: Changing an authorized native rule changes context-grounded planning while runtime source calculations remain governed.
experiments.unknown: Rule retrieval scope and practical adherence by each consumer.
procedure: Run a question with a rule requiring latest common complete month.
Create a reviewed rule revision with an explicit different allowed period policy.
Invalidate context and rerun without altering the application prompt or scenario code.
Inspect retrieved rule revision and selected period in the validated plan.
Attempt a rule that requests an unauthorized action and confirm runtime denies it.
experiments.pass: Plan reflects the relevant permitted rule revision; rules remain data/grounding, never authority to execute arbitrary tools or bypass permissions.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Record consumer adherence failure; validator enforces independently specified executable constraints with explicit provenance.

experiments.title: Namespace collision and invalid identity merge
experiments.hypothesis: Namespaced Customer and Revenue senses remain distinct until approved identity/metric contracts align them.
experiments.unknown: Agent auto-merge heuristics and native context exposure of qualified identities.
procedure: Create identical display names with different keys and business meanings across two domains.
Review automatic merge proposals and preserve namespace-qualified identities.
Query each sense and an ambiguous phrase.
Rename a namespace and inspect references and source links.
experiments.pass: No accidental merge; valid references survive rename; ambiguous questions clarify or select the evidenced intended sense.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Use qualified display names plus explicit mappings and disclose namespace feature limitations.

experiments.title: Inheritance and shared-property rollout
experiments.hypothesis: Enabled native inheritance/reuse preserves documented single-parent, direct-child and local-binding semantics.
experiments.unknown: Tenant rollout, shared-property type representation, cross-ontology permissions and export fidelity.
procedure: Create base Service, direct children and one grandchild in a disposable ontology.
Bind children separately, create a base relationship and test whether it propagates.
Query base and inspect direct-child/grandchild coverage.
Create shared metadata, local override, base edit and soft detach.
Compare conceptual types with actual TMDL and optional cross-ontology reader permissions.
experiments.pass: Observed behavior matches documented limits or is recorded as a discrepancy; app does not assume recursive polymorphism, binding inheritance or model-measure inheritance.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Keep the core multi-model proof working; mark native reuse feature unavailable rather than emulating it without a label.

experiments.title: Version restoration and metadata fidelity
experiments.hypothesis: Named native versions preserve the required ontology state independently from source data.
experiments.unknown: Conflict between current version UI docs and legacy FAQ, and actual scope of restored metrics/bindings/rules.
procedure: Create a named version with entities, metrics, rules and source links.
Make a reviewed ontology change and a separate source-data change.
Restore the ontology version and compare its census and query context.
Test rule description/synonym export loss separately from native restoration.
Optionally test RDF/TTL roundtrip into a new empty item, preserving import loss reports.
experiments.pass: Restoration coverage is explicit; source data is not incorrectly claimed restored; lossy metadata fields are detected.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Retain original working items and documented manual recovery; do not promise automatic rollback.

experiments.title: Data-agent ontology context over semantic models
experiments.hypothesis: The September context-source preview can consume the intended multi-model ontology in the selected environment.
experiments.unknown: Rollout and mismatch between announcement, older source restrictions and unresolved new documentation links.
procedure: Re-read current official context-source guidance and record version/date.
After approval, create a separate data-agent experiment and add the ontology as context through the supported surface.
Compare direct model-source configuration with ontology-context configuration.
Run metric, rule and cross-model cases; inspect generated queries and provenance.
Publish/test external MCP only through its documented integration.
experiments.pass: Actual results and traces prove the intended context was used and match independent known answers; no conclusion from merely accepting an item.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Mark unavailable/inconclusive; retain custom ontology-plus-IQ-MCP architecture and portal reference lane.

experiments.title: Source fidelity: Delta, Iceberg, shortcuts and Direct Lake
experiments.hypothesis: The same logical synthetic enterprise produces equivalent governed answers across supported source configurations.
experiments.unknown: Exact binding/grounding support for managed Delta versus shortcut/Iceberg sources and each Direct Lake mode.
procedure: Establish managed-Delta/Direct-Lake baseline.
After separate cost approval, build actual Snowflake/Iceberg and shortcut lane or clearly labelled non-Snowflake compatibility lane.
Test case/accent behavior, timestamp-without-zone, fixed decimals and schema changes.
Record Direct Lake on OneLake versus SQL endpoint and any query fallback.
Compare row counts, mapping coverage, measure results and metadata persistence.
experiments.pass: Supported configurations preserve declared semantics; unsupported or changed behavior is captured without calling a shortcut simulation a production reproduction.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Use managed Delta for core demo; keep source-path fidelity gap visible.

experiments.title: Graph eligibility is optional and source-specific
experiments.hypothesis: The lab can distinguish schema-path visualization from eligible physical graph materialization.
experiments.unknown: Actual eligibility/status reporting and refresh behavior of the selected optional network subgraph.
procedure: Inspect semantic-model-bound entity eligibility without materializing the whole ontology.
On a separate approved physical-Delta subset, select eligible entities and relationships.
If materialized, compare traversal answers and refresh lag with an independent edge oracle.
Record cost, data copied and projection limitations.
experiments.pass: No GQL claim over unsupported semantic-model bindings; optional physical graph matches its own scoped oracle.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Omit instance graph; show native schema/plan paths with an explicit nonmaterialized label.

experiments.title: Result bounds, CSV, nulls and partial errors
experiments.hypothesis: Every adapter detects incomplete results and preserves null/type semantics.
experiments.unknown: Runtime row/value/byte bounds and result envelope differences across IQ, ontology-agent and optional data-agent/REST paths.
procedure: Test 200/201, 250/251 and 1000/1001 result rows as applicable to each interface.
Exercise embedded CSV, quotes/newlines, nulls, empty results and large decimal values.
Inject or produce bounded partial failures and HTTP-200 error envelopes.
Compare partitioned retrieval with a full independently known cohort.
Verify final answers cannot state complete totals from incomplete artifacts.
experiments.pass: Completeness is proven or explicitly PARTIAL; parsers preserve types/nulls and errors are not converted to zero.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Reduce query grain or use explicit qualified partial answer; never silently truncate.

experiments.title: Cross-model temporal joins and non-additive measures
experiments.hypothesis: The application-owned executor correctly combines governed per-model outputs without fan-out or temporal misattribution.
experiments.unknown: Practical cohort propagation cost and decomposition feasibility for large distinct/ratio/median calculations.
procedure: Test one-to-many, many-to-many, overlapping validity intervals, reused keys and unmapped rows.
Test snapshot sums, weighted rates, distinct counts across batches and median recombination traps.
Exercise valid disjoint key partitions and non-disjoint batches.
Compare results to the independent synthetic oracle at smoke and standard scale.
Reject declared cardinality violations and report cohort coverage.
experiments.pass: Counts and currency reconcile; correct temporal population preserved; invalid decompositions are rejected or recomputed at source.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Constrain answer grain and clearly report a blocked/incomplete calculation rather than using LLM arithmetic.

experiments.title: Cold-cache concurrency, invalidation and load
experiments.hypothesis: Permission-aware session reuse and single-flight schema loads reduce avoidable fan-out without leaking cross-user context.
experiments.unknown: Observed latency, throttling, schema fan-out and capacity requirements of this specific synthetic app.
procedure: Stage 1, 5, 15 and 30 concurrent-user synthetic workloads with approved budgets.
Separate same-principal same-model misses from different-principal security scopes.
Record active users, request rate, session initialization, in-flight tools, source time and client time independently.
Trigger token expiry, permission revocation, schema revision and ontology revision.
Honor Retry-After, cancel selected requests, and verify no retry storms.
experiments.pass: Same-scope simultaneous misses coalesce, cross-scope data remains isolated, latency boundaries reconcile and no unbounded fan-out occurs.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Report bottleneck and reduce concurrency; do not silently resize capacity or extrapolate production user capacity.

experiments.title: Fair context ablation and held-out generalization
experiments.hypothesis: Native ontology context adds measurable benefit over normal metadata and an equally informative flat catalogue.
experiments.unknown: Effect size and whether observed gains come from content, retrieval, representation or a different agent.
procedure: Run A normal metadata, B equal-information flat context, C native ontology plus same app, and D native portal reference separately.
Freeze data, LLM version, prompts, budgets and reader identity within each block.
Use held-out paraphrases/compositions and multiple seeds; randomize arm order.
Separate cold/warm runs and store prompt/context hashes.
Grade numeric/cohort correctness independently; measure calls/tokens/cost/latency and lifecycle effort.
experiments.pass: Comparison is reproducible and unbiased; results include confidence/variance and failures even if ontology does not improve accuracy.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Narrow the claim to the demonstrated benefit; never manufacture a headline win.

experiments.title: Cross-workspace source ownership
experiments.hypothesis: Selected distributed-domain models can be consumed through a supported cross-workspace configuration.
experiments.unknown: Source discovery, model grounding, permissions and link behavior beyond the same-workspace documented bootstrap.
procedure: Retain working same-workspace baseline.
Move or redeploy copies of two models into separately approved domain workspaces.
Try only documented cross-workspace integration paths and inspect actual lineage/access.
Repeat multi-model metric and RLS questions.
Do not assume a semantic model can be shortcut like a lakehouse table.
experiments.pass: Distributed path retains correct source identities, permissions and answers, or its unsupported boundary is explicit.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Keep same-workspace educational topology and disclose distributed-ownership fidelity gap.

experiments.title: Canonical metric reuse and downstream drift
experiments.hypothesis: Source-controlled metric promotion detects and reconciles intentionally copied downstream definitions without claiming native model inheritance.
experiments.unknown: Required notebook/TMDL/CI sequencing and answer consistency after measure, relationship and security changes.
procedure: Create two downstream models using reviewed shared metric templates.
Intentionally leave one at an older metric version.
Detect drift from identity/version/definition manifests, not display name alone.
Promote an approved change including dependency and RLS/OLS checks.
Refresh ontology context and repeat source and multi-model oracle questions.
experiments.pass: Drift is visible before promotion; approved versions reconcile; broken dependencies/security do not pass as a successful sync.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Keep explicit manually reviewed promotion with recorded gaps; do not claim automatic inheritance.

experiments.title: Optional data-agent Tasks recovery
experiments.hypothesis: The selected SDK/server pair supports the negotiated asynchronous task lifecycle.
experiments.unknown: Protocol extension revision, pending/input states, reconnect, cancellation and final-result envelope.
procedure: Discover task capabilities during initialization and pin extension revision.
Submit one approved synthetic long-running question and record the actual task ID.
Poll using supported methods and server hints, handle input-required if exposed.
Reconnect and cancel a second task without duplicate submission.
Verify final failure/expiry/cancel results are not presented as successful answers.
experiments.pass: Observed task state machine is handled without invented methods, duplicate paid work or orphaned background execution.
experiments.ifUnsupported: Use bounded synchronous operation or disable optional data-agent lane.

releaseClaimPolicy: PASS is necessary but not sufficient: a result that correctly detects an unsupported feature passes experiment hygiene, not the feature claim. Claim gates also require the recorded feature outcome to be SUPPORTED with evidence.
